title: Twenty-five Years of Advanced RadioTherapy at San Raffaele Hospital
official: "Twenty-five Years of Advanced RadioTherapy (ART), With Intensity Modulation, Image-guidance, and Stereotactic Radiotherapy, With Classic Fractionation, Moderate- or Ultra-hypofractionation at San Raffaele Hospital "
summary: This retrospective observational study aims to evaluate the efficacy and toxicity of advanced radiotherapy (ART) techniques, including intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT), image-guided radiotherapy (IGRT), and stereotactic radiotherapy (SRT), used at IRCCS Ospedale San Raffaele over the past 25 years and 5 months. The study includes treatments delivered using conventional fractionation, moderate hypofractionation, and ultra-hypofractionation. The primary endpoint is local control, defined as biochemical control in patients with prostate cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cancer
* Patients with benign tumors/conditions
* Treated with advanced radiotherapy techniques (IMRT, IGRT, SBRT, including Gamma Knife, CyberKnife, Tomotherapy, VMAT machines)
* Treated between January 2001 and May 2026

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cancer
* Treated with 2D or 3D conformational radiotherapy,
* Treated with palliative radiotherapy, not including an advanced radiotherapy technique
* Treated before January 2001 or after May 2026
